subject: Throughput validation and swap window schedule for Helios Reserved Capacity
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <dani@helios.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Planning throughput validation run + swap window for Reserved (Helios)

Danielle — following up from Friday's call. We have the reserved capacity cluster sized per the numbers in the quote, but before we do the DNS/service swap we want to run a short throughput validation and one controlled swap window. Goal: validate steady-state throughput at target p95 latency and ensure graceful fallback.

Proposed scope:
- 2-hour validation load test against the reserved endpoints (warm KV cache, realistic routing)
- Verify 99th/95th token latency, sustained tokens/sec, and error rate under peak concurrency
- Run quick rollback test (traffic split 90/10 -> 0/100) to confirm fallback policies

Proposed windows (PST):
- Friday Dec 4, 09:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Monday Dec 7, 14:00–16:00 (backup)

Irene — can you own the test plan and coordinate with Marcus and Dev to run the validation? Marcus — I’ll need a concise checklist you can run and the minimum acceptance gates. Danielle / Procurement — please confirm the preferred window; if procurement needs notice for change control, loop them in.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Park <dani@helios.ai>, CloudOps AWS Partner <aws-partner@cloudops.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Planning throughput validation run + swap window for Reserved (Helios)

Thanks — I will drive the validation plan. Short plan and acceptance gates below. Marcus / Dev please confirm you can run this on Dec 7 (backup) and prepare the artifacts for Dec 4 if procurement approves an exception.

Validation plan (owner: Irene):
1) Preflight (30m)
   - Confirm reserved nodes are healthy, kernel/driver versions match prod profile, disk I/O and GPU temps nominal
   - Confirm model variant rwin-3b-q4_0 is deployed to reserved pool and weights verified

2) Warm (20m)
   - Warm KV cache with representative session prefixes; verify cache hit rate >= 85%

3) Throughput run (60m)
   - Step load to target concurrency (as per Helios trace) over 15m ramp, sustain 45m
   - Monitor p50/p95/p99 token latency, tokens/sec, GPU utl, and error rate

4) Swap test (10m)
   - Traffic split 90% hosted / 10% reserved for 5m, observe telemetry; then 100% reserved for 2m, then rollback to hosted to validate fallback

Acceptance gates (all required):
- p95 token latency < 420ms for completion requests
- sustained tokens/sec within +/-10% of quoted throughput
- error rate < 0.5% (5 errors per 1000 requests)
- KV cache hit >= 80% after warm

Artifacts to produce:
- helios_throughput_test_results.csv (per-minute metrics)
- runbook: reserved-swap-runbook-v1.pdf (timeline, run commands, rollback steps)
- post-run notes and suggested config tweaks

Marcus / Dev: confirm resource availability for Dec 7 14:00–16:00 (backup) and whether you need any additional test keys or whitelists from Helios.

Irene Choi
Product Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Park <dani@helios.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Planning throughput validation run + swap window for Reserved (Helios)

All set for Dec 7 backup window. Quick notes from our staging run earlier today (summarized; full CSV attached):

- Staging run used Helios-sampled trace, q4_0, model rwin-3b-q4_0.
- Observed sustained tokens/sec: 14,200 (target 15,500) -> ~8.4% below quoted, within acceptance +/-10%
- p95 token latency: 380ms; p99: 620ms (p99 spikes during a single long-seq pattern)
- Error rate: 0.27% (spikes were retries when we hit a short-lived kernel OOM on one node, NV switch patched)
- KV cache hit after warm: 86%

Attachments: helios_throughput_test_results.csv (summary metrics), staging-brief.txt

Action items before Dec 7:
- Patch the one node with driver roll-forward (we scheduled maintenance for Dec 5)
- Add a short-tail traffic generator to better cover long-sequence cases
- Add an automated rollback hook that will flip traffic in under 90s if error rate crosses 1%

I'll upload the runbook and CSV to the Drive link Irene included.

Marcus Lin
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <dani@helios.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Scheduled validation and swap confirmed for Dec 7 14:00–16:00 PST

Thank you all — procurement confirmed the change board acceptance for Dec 7. Final schedule and roles below: 

- 13:30–14:00 PST: preflight verification (Marcus)
- 14:00–14:20 PST: warm and KV validation (Dev)
- 14:20–15:05 PST: throughput run (Irene)
- 15:05–15:15 PST: swap test (Irene + Marcus)
- 15:15–16:00 PST: cool-down, post-run telemetry, and decision (Irene + Helios)

Rollback criteria (immediate rollback): error rate > 1% sustained for 2 minutes OR p95 token latency > 650ms for >5 minutes.

Helios procurement: thank you for the coordination — please confirm that your change ticket number is CHG-HELIOS-2211 and that your on-call is available during the window.

I will push the runbook (reserved-swap-runbook-v1.pdf) and the CSV from Marcus to the shared Drive and post-run will send the summarized acceptance report.

Irene Choi
Product Ops | Redwood Inference
